summary: Iter 249 — Full E2E validation of PDPL redaction, RRR Memory Engine (5 rules), Daily Summary (per-day + role-based + toggle), and regression of all Katrina flows. Backend: 122/123 legacy pytest + 5/6 new tests PASS (1 skipped legitimately, 1 legacy failure is a duplicate-pending detection false-positive from stale draft — dedup itself works). Frontend: settings toggle + memory stats + drawer all verified.

minor.issue: Fails with policy='duplicate_pending' instead of 'manual_review_required' — caused by stale identical pending draft from prior iterations (dedup is working correctly). Test needs unique amount per run, not an app bug.

action_items: (Optional/low priority) Fix test_execute_text_purchase_produces_ONE_pending_approval to use uuid-based unique amount so stale duplicate drafts don't false-flag it (or clean up test data between suites).
critical_code_review_comments: PDPL redaction verified end-to-end: customer search for 'غانم' returns LLM narrative with phone shown as '—' (masked). Cards remain unredacted as designed (local-only cards).

Memory promotion four-eyes flow rock-solid: مدير propose → memory_promote approval draft; مدير self-approve → 403 four_eyes_violation; احمد1 approve → 200; knowledge counter incremented 1→2. Stats command 'الذاكرة' returns full Markdown block including token budget (~31/2000).

Daily summary per-day gate confirmed: 2nd session same day for مدير does NOT re-emit summary. New day (2026-07-03) DID re-emit as expected (fresh day = fresh summary). daily_summary=false body param cleanly suppresses summary for فرج1.
Role gating verified: فرج1 (accountant) summary has NO revenue line and is ≤5 lines (observed 2 lines: date header + '✨ لا معلقات لديك').
Drawer settings toggle flips label between 'مفعّل' ↔ 'موقوف' and persists to localStorage assistant_daily_summary=on|off.

Toast notification container occasionally intercepts pointer events on FAB — a minor UX concern for automation and possibly real users clicking during first-load. JS click bypasses it. Consider pointer-events:none on toast wrapper.

Assistant response schema wraps {success, data:{response, tool_results, executed}}. memory_promote executed payload does not always surface the outer approval id in a single top-level field; downstream automation must fall back to /api/runtime/approvals list. Consider adding explicit executed.approval_id.

success_rate.backend: 99.2% (122/123 legacy + 5/6 new; 1 legacy stale-data false-positive, 1 legitimate skip)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (drawer, settings toggle, memory stats command all verified)

test_credentials: name-only login: مدير (admin/approver), احمد1 (supervisor/approver), فرج1 (accountant/no-approve). Ref /app/memory/test_credentials.md
seed_data_creation: Added 1 knowledge entry via memory_promote approval (unique 'رقم صندوق البريد التجريبي هو <hex>') — kept as intended (harmless). No purchase drafts created this iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Env date: 2026-07-03. Memory stats block regex marker: 'ذاكرة كاترينا'. To trigger memory_promote: 'احفظ في المعرفة: <fact>'. Approval id must be fetched from GET /api/runtime/approvals?status=pending (payload.action=='memory_promote'); executed.id in chat response maps to draft_id, NOT the outer approval id (documented in iter 248 as well). Daily-summary once-per-day is Mongo-backed via assistant_daily_state; per-day roll-over produces a fresh summary on the new date (correct). Frontend testids used: unified-assistant-fab, assistant-settings-btn, assistant-daily-summary-toggle, assistant-input, assistant-send-btn. localStorage key: assistant_daily_summary ('on'/'off'). Toast container can intercept FAB clicks — use JS click() as workaround.
